hero.label: Mendix Consulting · Remote
hero.headline: We helped build the Mendix ecosystem. Now we help you navigate it.
hero.subtext: We guide organisations and Mendix partners from adoption to genuine capability — from upgrading a stalled Mx9 platform to preparing your team for agentic AI development with the guardrails enterprises actually need.

problem.headline: Start is the easy part.
problem.body: Most Mendix teams build their first app and hit a wall they can't diagnose. Complexity creeps in, standards don't exist, and the next phase never arrives. The platform gets the blame. The real gap is knowing what to do after go-live.
problem.punchline: We know which phase you're in. And exactly how to move you forward.
problem.timing_body: Mendix 11 is fully committed to agentic AI development — with built-in guardrails that make it the safest way for enterprises to put AI into production. Raw AI coding tools move fast but leave governance gaps. Mendix closes them by design. Most organisations are still on Mendix 9. The teams that benefit will be the ones building the right foundation today.

services.label: What we do
services.headline: From first sprint to full CoE. We cover the full Mendix lifecycle.
services.item1_desc: We start by understanding where you are. A structured review of your Mendix adoption, team capability, and platform usage — with a clear picture of what's blocking progress.
services.item1_meta: Delivered as a scored report across 6 dimensions · Typical duration: 2 weeks
services.item2_desc: Mendix is concentrating all future development — including agentic AI capabilities — in Mendix 11. Everything below is becoming legacy. We start with an intake and scope determination, mapping your business rules and custom work together with your team, then execute a direct upgrade to Mx11. Skip the intermediate step. Get there once, get there ready.
services.item3_desc: Hands-on Mendix development, sprint delivery, and technical guidance — whether you need us for a single phase or as a long-term extension of your team.
services.partner_note: Mendix partner looking for senior capacity on a complex engagement?
services.item4_desc: Governance, standards, architecture decisions, and application landscape management. A proper CoE is the organisational guardrail layer that makes agentic AI safe to deploy at scale — not just for Mendix, but for your entire platform strategy.

process.label: How we work
process.headline: From where you are to where you need to be.
process.step1_desc: We start with a structured Mendix Maturity Assessment — platform usage, team capability, governance gaps. This becomes the baseline for everything that follows.
process.step2_title: We define where you need to be
process.step2_desc: A clear target — realistic, time-bound, and aligned with your business goals.
process.step3_desc: We work embedded with your team, share every decision, and leave you capable of running it yourself.
process.step4_desc: Some clients want a capable team that runs independently. Others want ongoing delivery support. We're flexible — the engagement ends when it makes sense, not before.

about.label: About us
about.headline: Dutch expertise. Remote-first. Built for global.
about.body: We built our careers inside Mendix and Siemens — starting at Mendix NL and brought to Seoul in 2022 by Siemens Korea to deliver a worldwide GTM application for a global enterprise client. That project rooted us in the region. Since then, we have guided organisations across East Asia and Europe through the technical and organisational side of digital transformation — bridging the European way of working with how APAC teams actually operate.
about.body2: A track record with enterprise clients in Korea, Taiwan, Japan, and Europe. English and Dutch. Remote-first, and happy to travel when it matters.
about.body3: We also work directly with Mendix partners who need senior capacity on complex engagements. If you need backup, we are available.
about.danny_role: Digital Transformation · Solution Architect · Tech Lead
about.jessy_role: Digital Transformation · Project Management · Product Owner

contact.label: Get in touch
contact.headline: Ready to talk?
contact.subtext: Tell us where you are with Mendix and what's blocking you. We'll take it from there. Engagements are scoped and priced after an initial conversation. Most start with a maturity assessment. Working language: English.
contact.cta_followup: We respond within 24 hours and include a booking link if there's a fit.
contact.partner_body: We work directly with partners who need senior capacity on complex engagements — as sub-contractor or direct extension, white-labelled or credited, your preference.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.headline: Common questions.
faq.q1: What does a Maturity Assessment include?
faq.a1: A structured review across six dimensions: platform usage, team capability, governance, architecture, AI readiness, and organisational maturity. The output is a scored report that we discuss together — either right away or in a planned follow-up — to pinpoint the topics worth setting up or improving. It is a collaborative starting point, not a document drop.
faq.a2: Yes. We work worldwide, remote-first. We have delivered for clients in Korea, Taiwan, Japan, the Netherlands, and beyond. Large timezone differences are manageable — we discuss upfront how to structure communication so it works for both sides.
faq.q3: Can you work alongside our existing team?
faq.a3: Yes. We do hands-on Mendix development, work alongside your existing developers, or both. Some clients need us to deliver; others need us to coach and guide their team. Most engagements end up being a mix — we adapt to what the situation actually requires.
faq.q4: How are engagements scoped and priced?
faq.a4: We scope and price after an initial conversation. There is no fixed rate card — engagements vary by size, duration, and complexity. We will be direct about what makes sense.

footer.tagline: Mendix expertise for the teams that need it.
